==Description==
'''The Z Step''' is an interactable [[Emotes|emote]] that could be obtained from reaching Rank 15 on the [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though players will make zombie groaning sounds. You can move while performing this emote. Notably, you automatically move when performing the emote, going in a specific direction that can be changed by pressing any of the movement keys or by using the joystick on mobile. 

When a player performs '''The Z Step''', nearby players can interact with the performer. Doing so causes them to perform the same emote as well.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 15 on the [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]], which had a cost of {{Pumpkins|4,800 Pumpkins}} or {{Robux|640}} at that rank. The total cost to buy all ranks from Rank 1 to Rank 15 was {{Robux|5,040}}.

==Trivia==
*This and [[Demon Swing]] are the only two emotes to not use a green blue Robloxian or a white character on its icon, as '''The Z Step''' uses a zombie.
**The face of the zombie is based on the ﾟдﾟ emoticon, popularized from 2channel. The same face was used by some enemies from the [[Halloween 2020 Event]].
*The groans made while performing '''The Z Step''' are the same ones made by the zombies summoned by the {{RLinkC|26421972|Zombie Staff}}, a popular Roblox gear.
*This and [[Conga]] are the first emotes to be interactable with other players.
